# 1 Enoch Chapter 90 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams — Animal Apocalypse

---

**90:1** And-I-saw-in-the-vision-how-the-ravens-flew-upon-those-lambs-and-took-one-of-those-lambs, and-dashed-the-sheep-in-pieces-and-devoured-them.

**90:2** And-I-saw-till-horns-grew-upon-those-lambs, and-the-ravens-cast-down-their-horns; and-I-saw-till-there-sprouted-a-great-horn-of-one-of-those-sheep, and-their-eyes-were-opened.

**90:3** And-it-looked-at-them [and-their-eyes-opened], and-it-cried-to-the-sheep, and-the-rams-saw-it-and-all-ran-to-it.

**90:4** And-notwithstanding-all-this-those-eagles-and-vultures-and-ravens-and-kites-still-kept-tearing-the-sheep-and-swooping-down-upon-them-and-devouring-them: still-the-sheep-remained-silent, but-the-rams-lamented-and-cried-out.

**90:5** And-those-ravens-fought-and-battled-with-it-[the-great-horn] and-sought-to-lay-low-its-horn, but-they-had-no-power-over-it.

**90:6** And-I-saw-till-the-shepherds-and-eagles-and-those-vultures-and-kites-came, and-they-cried-to-the-ravens-that-they-should-break-the-horn-of-that-ram, and-they-battled-and-fought-with-it, and-it-fought-with-them-and-cried-out-that-its-help-might-come.

**90:7** And-I-saw-till-that-man-who-wrote-down-the-names-of-the-shepherds-and-carried-up-the-book-to-the-Lord-of-the-sheep-came-and-helped-it-and-showed-it-everything: he-had-come-down-for-the-help-of-that-ram.

**90:8** And-I-saw-till-the-Lord-of-the-sheep-came-unto-them-in-wrath, and-all-who-saw-Him-fled-and-they-all-fell-into-His-shadow-from-before-His-face.

**90:9** All-the-eagles-and-vultures-and-ravens-and-kites-were-gathered-together, and-there-came-with-them-all-the-sheep-of-the-field, yea, they-all-came-together, and-helped-each-other-to-break-that-horn-of-the-ram.

**90:10** And-I-saw-that-man, who-wrote-the-book-according-to-the-command-of-the-Lord, till-he-opened-that-book-concerning-the-destruction-which-those-twelve-last-shepherds-had-wrought, and-showed-that-they-had-destroyed-much-more-than-their-predecessors, before-the-Lord-of-the-sheep.

**90:11** And-I-saw-till-the-Lord-of-the-sheep-came-unto-them-and-took-in-His-hand-the-staff-of-His-wrath, and-smote-the-earth, and-the-earth-clave-asunder, and-all-the-beasts-and-all-the-birds-of-the-heaven-fell-from-the-midst-of-those-sheep, and-were-swallowed-up-in-the-earth-and-it-covered-them.

**90:12** And-I-saw-till-a-great-sword-was-given-to-the-sheep, and-the-sheep-proceeded-against-all-the-beasts-of-the-field-to-slay-them, and-all-the-beasts-and-the-birds-of-the-heaven-fled-before-their-face.

**90:13** And-I-saw-that-man-sitting-on-a-lofty-throne-of-judgment-and-the-books-of-the-living-were-opened-before-Him, and-all-His-host-and-His-whole-court-stood-before-Him, and-the-hearts-of-all-were-filled-with-joy-because-that-man-had-been-protected-and-written-therein.

**90:14** And-I-saw-till-those-seventy-shepherds-were-judged-and-found-guilty-and-cast-into-that-fiery-abyss.

**90:15** And-I-saw-that-man-cast-into-an-abyss, full-of-fire, flaming-and-full-of-pillars-of-fire: and-those-seventy-shepherds-were-judged-and-found-guilty-and-cast-into-that-fiery-abyss.

**90:16** And-I-saw-at-that-time-how-a-like-abyss-was-opened-in-the-midst-of-the-earth, full-of-fire, and-they-brought-those-blinded-sheep, and-they-were-all-judged-and-found-guilty-and-cast-into-this-fiery-abyss-and-they-burned; now-this-abyss-was-to-the-right-of-that-house.

**90:17** And-I-saw-those-sheep-burning-and-their-bones-burning.

**90:18** And-I-stood-up-to-see-till-they-folded-up-that-old-house; and-carried-off-all-the-pillars, and-all-the-beams-and-ornaments-of-the-house-were-at-the-same-time-folded-up-with-it, and-they-carried-it-off-and-laid-it-in-a-place-in-the-south-of-the-land.

**90:19** And-I-saw-till-the-Lord-of-the-sheep-brought-a-new-house-greater-and-loftier-than-that-first, and-set-it-up-in-the-place-of-the-first-which-had-been-folded-up: all-its-pillars-were-new, and-its-ornaments-were-new-and-larger-than-those-of-the-first, the-old-one-which-He-had-taken-away, and-all-the-sheep-were-within-it.

**90:20** And-I-saw-all-the-sheep-which-had-been-left, and-all-the-beasts-on-the-earth, and-all-the-birds-of-the-heaven, falling-down-and-doing-homage-to-those-sheep-and-making-petition-to-and-obeying-them-in-everything.

**90:21** And-thereafter-those-three-who-were-clothed-in-white-and-had-seized-me-by-my-hand-who-had-taken-me-up-before, and-the-hand-of-that-ram-also-seizing-hold-of-me, they-took-me-up-and-set-me-down-in-the-midst-of-those-sheep-before-the-judgment-took-place.

**90:22** And-those-sheep-were-all-white, and-their-wool-was-abundant-and-clean.

**90:23** And-all-that-had-been-destroyed-and-dispersed, and-all-the-beasts-of-the-field, and-all-the-birds-of-the-heaven, assembled-in-that-house, and-the-Lord-of-the-sheep-rejoiced-with-great-joy-because-they-were-all-good-and-had-returned-to-His-house.

**90:24** And-I-saw-till-they-laid-down-that-sword, which-had-been-given-to-the-sheep, and-they-brought-it-back-into-the-house, and-it-was-sealed-before-the-presence-of-the-Lord; and-all-the-sheep-were-invited-into-that-house, but-it-held-them-not.

**90:25** And-the-eyes-of-them-all-were-opened, and-they-saw-the-good, and-there-was-not-one-among-them-that-did-not-see.

**90:26** And-I-saw-that-that-house-was-large-and-broad-and-very-full.

**90:27** And-I-saw-that-a-white-bull-was-born, with-large-horns-and-all-the-beasts-of-the-field-and-all-the-birds-of-the-air-feared-him-and-made-petition-to-him-all-the-time.

**90:28** And-I-saw-till-all-their-generations-were-transformed, and-they-all-became-white-bulls; and-the-first-among-them-became-a-lamb, and-that-lamb-became-a-great-animal-and-had-great-black-horns-on-its-head; and-the-Lord-of-the-sheep-rejoiced-over-it-and-over-all-the-oxen.

**90:29** And-I-slept-in-their-midst: and-I-awoke-and-saw-everything.

**90:30** This-is-the-vision-which-I-saw-while-I-slept, and-I-awoke-and-blessed-the-Lord-of-righteousness-and-gave-Him-glory.

**90:31** Then-I-wept-with-a-great-weeping-and-my-tears-stayed-not-till-I-could-no-longer-endure-it: when-I-saw, they-flowed-on-account-of-what-I-had-seen; for-everything-shall-come-and-be-fulfilled, and-all-the-deeds-of-men-in-their-order-were-shown-to-me.

**90:32** On-that-night-I-remembered-the-first-dream, and-because-of-it-I-wept-and-was-troubled-because-I-had-seen-that-vision.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Chapter 90 is the climax of the Animal Apocalypse and one of the most theologically significant passages in all Second Temple literature. The 'horned lambs' with a 'great horn' (vv. 1-9) = the Maccabees and Judas Maccabeus (the great horn). The final judgment (vv. 11-17) destroys all enemies and evil shepherds. The new house (v. 19) = the New Jerusalem. The white bull with great horns (v. 27) = the Messiah. The transformation of all into white bulls (v. 28) = the eschatological restoration of all creation to Adamic perfection. The final crying of Enoch (vv. 31-32) frames the whole vision as deeply moving.*
